IGUI_TGI_Opt_actionBar_tt: Shows what the character is doing (reloading, putting on...) and how long is left, above the hotbar
IGUI_TGI_NoNest: Can't put a bag inside itself
IGUI_TGI_Hint: Drag, R rotate, Ctrl move, Alt equip, Shift half, Dbl-click open
IGUI_TGI_OptAutoSearch_tt: Search opened containers without pressing Search
IGUI_TGI_OptIconMenu_tt: Icon entry in the item context menu
IGUI_TGI_OptReplace_tt: Inventory key opens TGI and hides vanilla windows. Otherwise TGI opens with I
IGUI_TGI_NoRun: Backpack is not reachable while running
IGUI_TGI_OptHotbar_tt: Value tiles, key, slot name, drag and drop from the inventory
IGUI_TGI_OptQuick_tt: 4 cells next to the hotbar: drop a bandage, pills, food or water there and use it with a key
IGUI_TGI_Opt_replaceVanilla_tt: The inventory key opens TGI, vanilla windows are hidden. Can't be turned off while the search rule is on (sandbox / server).
IGUI_TGI_Opt_nearHighlight_tt: Outline the nearest container in the world, like the vanilla loot window
IGUI_TGI_Opt_autoSearch_tt: Search opened containers without pressing Search
IGUI_TGI_Opt_autoSort_tt: Keep opened containers sorted by type: weapons, ammo, medicine, food, drinks, tools, clothing, bags (after they are searched)
IGUI_TGI_Opt_slotHighlight_tt: Green frame on equipment slots the item fits
IGUI_TGI_Opt_valueTiers_tt: Coloured gradient on tiles by item value
IGUI_TGI_Opt_hotbarStyle_tt: Tiles, key, slot name, drag and drop from the inventory
IGUI_TGI_Opt_hotbarAmmo_tt: Rounds in the gun, spare magazines and loose rounds
IGUI_TGI_Opt_hotbarInfo_tt: Weight, light battery, ammo in hands
IGUI_TGI_Opt_quickSlots_tt: 4 cells next to the hotbar for bandages, pills, food and water
IGUI_TGI_QuickNoWeapon: Quick slots are for consumables, not weapons
IGUI_TGI_Unlock3: Searching 3: you can tell what kind of thing is hidden
IGUI_TGI_Unlock4: Searching 4: stashes are recognised at once
IGUI_TGI_Unlock6: Searching 6: the most valuable thing is found first
IGUI_TGI_Unlock8: Searching 8: you see the rarity of hidden items
IGUI_perks_Searching_Description: Finding things faster in containers. Rare finds teach more than junk. Bonuses at levels 3, 4, 5, 6, 8 and 10.
IGUI_TGI_LootLeft: %1 items did not fit and stayed in the container
IGUI_TGI_Opt_invKeys_tt: While the inventory is open it takes the keyboard (arrows, hotkeys). Off: every key reaches the game, hotkeys keep working.
IGUI_TGI_Opt_colorPreset_tt: A ready set of colours over the theme: background, cells, frames and text.
IGUI_TGI_Opt_fontFace_tt: Font of the inventory text. Chinese always uses the game font.
IGUI_TGI_Opt_returnItems_tt: When the game takes something out of a bag to use it (eat, smoke, read, craft), it goes back to the same bag and place afterwards.
IGUI_TGI_Opt_tileColor_tt: What colours the item tiles: what the thing is (weapons rust, medicine red, food olive, rounds brass, tools steel), its value (grey to gold), or no colour.
IGUI_TGI_Opt_ownFont_tt: Draw all inventory text in the mod font (Jura or Tektur). Off: the game font (the modern style keeps Jura).
IGUI_TGI_BorrowedBag: %1 is still with you: put it back in the container
IGUI_TGI_Opt_ammoBoxCell_tt: Loose rounds take one cell per box (50 pistol rounds, 25 shells...). Off: all rounds of one kind share a cell.
IGUI_TGI_Opt_hotbarHideEmpty_tt: Only slots with an item are shown (all of them while dragging)
IGUI_TGI_Opt_uiAlpha_tt: Transparency of the inventory, hotbar and quick slots
IGUI_TGI_Opt_openSound_tt: Plays a bag sound when the inventory opens and closes
IGUI_TGI_Opt_healthOverlay_tt: Shows injuries on the body figure under your gear. Drag medicine onto a body part to treat it, food, drinks and pills onto the figure to use them. Turn off if a medical mod handles healing.
IGUI_TGI_H_Recovering: No wounds, the part is healing
IGUI_TGI_H_NothingToTreat: Nothing to treat here with this
IGUI_TGI_H_DragHint: Drag an item onto this part
IGUI_TGI_H_DoSplint: Splint (splint, or plank and ripped sheets)
IGUI_TGI_Opt_vitals_tt: Health, satiety and water bars under the gear
IGUI_TGI_Opt_vitalsMore_tt: Second row of bars: stamina, rest and body temperature
IGUI_TGI_Opt_cellScale_tt: Size of the grid cells and icons. Auto picks it from the screen height. Applies when the inventory opens
IGUI_TGI_Opt_searchedMarks_tt: A small tick over world containers you have searched to the end
IGUI_TGI_Opt_lootTabs_tt: Buttons for each nearby container next to the loot column, like vanilla: one container at a time, no scrolling
IGUI_TGI_Opt_gamepad_tt: Use the grid inventory with a gamepad. D-pad moves the cursor, A picks up and puts down, X quick-moves, Y opens the menu, RB rotates, LB/RB switch columns, B cancels or closes
IGUI_TGI_Opt_learnMarks_tt: A coloured "!" on items with something new for you: unread skill books (yellow), unknown recipes and items to research (green), unseen VHS and unheard CDs (blue), unread maps (orange)
IGUI_TGI_Opt_collectMarks_tt: A small white corner mark on books, magazines, comics, photos, VHS, CDs and maps you have never had in your inventory
IGUI_TGI_Opt_cookBar_tt: A bar on food being heated: thawing (blue), cooking until done (orange), done and getting closer to burnt (green to red)
IGUI_TGI_Opt_smoothUI_tt: While the inventory is open the interface is drawn every frame, even with "UI rendered separately" on, so it follows the mouse without lag. Your setting comes back when it closes.
IGUI_TGI_Opt_errorReports_tt: When an error touches the inventory, a notice shows which mod it may conflict with and lets you copy a ready report for the bug thread.
IGUI_TGI_RepOurs: An error in Tactical Grid Inventory.
IGUI_TGI_RepHint: Copy the report and paste it in the bug thread, it helps fix it fast.
IGUI_TGI_RepCopied: Report copied. Paste it in the discussion (Ctrl+V).
IGUI_TGI_Opt_hideCosmetic_tt: Faces, skins and similar worn items from other mods are not shown under 'Other' in the gear column.
IGUI_TGI_Opt_modernUI_tt: Flat Tarkov-like look: even tiles with a thin frame, names in the top right, flat headers. Work in progress.
IGUI_TGI_Opt_strictGrid_tt: Your pockets and bags never grow past their grid: if there is no free cell, you can't pick the item up. Pockets come only from clothes. Off: bags grow until the weight limit.
IGUI_TGI_Opt_dropOverflow_tt: When something you pick up does not fit your grids, put it on the floor. Off: it waits to the right of the grid until you make room.
IGUI_TGI_Opt_clothingPockets_tt: Clothes add pockets under your usual ones: trousers and a jacket give two each, a shirt one, a vest two small ones. Weight limits stay the same.
IGUI_TGI_NoPockets: No pockets: put on trousers, a jacket, a shirt or underwear
IGUI_TGI_Opt_fullscreen_tt: The inventory fills the whole screen instead of a window.
IGUI_TGI_RateText: You've played with Tactical Grid Inventory for a while. If you like it, a thumbs up on the Workshop page really helps the mod get seen and keeps me working on it.
IGUI_TGI_Opt_autoFoldLoot_tt: The loot part of the window folds away when there is nothing to loot nearby and opens again when you reach a container.
IGUI_TGI_Opt_sizeEditor_tt: Adds "Size..." to the item menu: change how many cells an item takes. Saved to Zomboid/Lua/TGI_sizes.txt; server admins can save sizes for everyone.
IGUI_TGI_Know_book: Skill book you have not read
IGUI_TGI_Know_recipe: Has recipes you do not know
IGUI_TGI_Know_research: Can be researched for a recipe
IGUI_TGI_LabelAsk: Label for this container (up to 24 letters):
IGUI_TGI_Opt_worldLabels_tt: Show your container labels over the containers near you
IGUI_TGI_Opt_noSearch_tt: Containers show everything right away, no searching. Multiplayer: only if the server allows it
IGUI_TGI_Opt_animations_tt: Soft fades: windows opening, things arriving in a grid, the highlight under the mouse
IGUI_TGI_Opt_failSafe_tt: If the inventory window keeps throwing errors, switch to the vanilla inventory until the game is restarted, so you are never left without one.
IGUI_TGI_Opt_strictOthers_tt: Moves started by other mods (Viewpoint, auto loot, crafting mods) also need a free cell. Off: they go through, and what does not fit waits in "does not fit".
IGUI_TGI_Opt_dragBridge_tt: Items dropped on another mod's window (a video deck, a crafting slot...) are handed over the vanilla way.
IGUI_TGI_Fallback: TGI: too many errors, vanilla inventory until restart
